_comment: P4626 Gate 4 allowlist. Objects here are KNOWN pre-existing multi-CREATE-OR-REPLACE offenders, grandfathered so the gate does not red-fail the whole repo on day one. They are reported as WARN. Any object NOT listed here with >1 forward-migration definer BLOCKS CI. Warn->block path: as each chain is consolidated to a single definer, delete its entry; new multi-writers block immediately. Generated from the live migration set at the P4626 baseline.
